GOAL
Build a premium event landing page for **“ARTIFACT: Museum Night”** — a ticketed night museum event with ticket selection, but no real payment.

TECH / STRICT
- One html file only.
- HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript only.
- No frameworks.
- No libraries.
- Inline CSS and inline JS.
- Remote images are allowed.
- Must work by opening the file directly in a browser.

DESIGN DIRECTION
Create a visually striking cinematic museum-night website.

The design should feel like:
- luxury museum after dark
- velvet darkness
- golden spotlights
- quiet mystery
- art-house cinema
- premium cultural event

Visual style:
- dark velvet / near-black background
- deep burgundy and midnight navy gradients
- soft spotlight effects
- elegant serif headlines
- modern readable sans-serif body text
- thin gold dividers
- subtle grain/noise overlay using CSS only
- large editorial hero layout
- asymmetric image cards
- glass-like dark panels
- premium ticket cards
- smooth hover states
- scroll reveal animations
- strong typography hierarchy

Color palette:
- Background: `#070506`
- Velvet: `#1a0710`
- Burgundy: `#3a0f1d`
- Midnight navy: `#07111f`
- Gold: `#d6ad60`
- Soft gold: `#f3d79b`
- Ivory text: `#f8efe2`
- Muted text: `#b9a999`
- Panel: `rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.06)`
- Border: `rgba(214, 173, 96, 0.28)`

TYPOGRAPHY
Use CSS font stacks only:
- Headlines: `Georgia`, `Times New Roman`, serif
- Body: `Inter`, `system-ui`, `Segoe UI`, sans-serif

LAYOUT
Single-page landing with sticky navbar and smooth scrolling.

SECTIONS

1. Navbar
- Logo: ARTIFACT
- Links:
  - Program
  - Artists
  - Venue
  - Tickets
  - FAQ
- CTA button: “Get Tickets”
- Active nav state while scrolling
- Mobile responsive menu

2. Hero
- Full cinematic hero section
- Large serif headline:
  “Museum Night, Reimagined”
- Event name:
  “ARTIFACT: Museum Night”
- Date/time/place:
  - 18 October 2026
  - 19:00–02:00
  - The Old Gallery, Warsaw
- CTAs:

- <title>ARTIFACT: Museum Night — A Cinematic After-Hours Museum Event</title>

=== SECTIONS (in order) ===

1) STICKY NAVBAR: fixed top, translucent dark blur background, thin gold bottom border. Left: logo "ARTIFACT" in Georgia serif with a small gold diamond ◆ and letter-spacing. Center/right links: Program, Artists, Venue, Tickets, FAQ (href="#program" etc.). Right: gold "Get Tickets" button (href="#tickets"). Active link state: gold text + small gold underline dot — toggled by JS while scrolling. Mobile: hamburger button (3 spans, animates to X) toggling a full-width dropdown panel with the links; aria-expanded/aria-controls; closes on link click.

2) HERO (#top, full viewport min-height:100vh): background image https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night (CSS background, cover/center) with layered overlays: dark gradient from #070506, a burgundy/navy corner gradient, and a soft radial "spotlight" gold glow from upper area; plus 1–2 absolutely positioned blurred radial spotlight divs. Content: eyebrow "ARTIFACT: MUSEUM NIGHT" (letter-spaced gold small caps), huge Georgia serif headline "Museum Night, Reimagined" (clamp ~3rem–6.5rem, ivory, italic accent word optional), short subline, metadata row of small glass badges with gold border: "18 October 2026", "19:00–02:00", "The Old Gallery, Warsaw". Two CTAs: gold "Get Tickets" (→#tickets) and ghost "Save to Calendar" (id used by JS to download .ics). Bottom: thin gold divider + subtle scroll indicator. Editorial asymmetric touch: a rotated thin serif caption or offset frame border.

3) CONCEPT / INTRO (#concept): editorial two-column-ish intro: small gold eyebrow "THE CONCEPT", serif heading, one elegant paragraph about one night when the museum stays awake — velvet darkness, golden spotlights, quiet mystery. Then 3 glass feature cards (hover: lift + gold border glow): "After-hours exhibitions" (galleries open past midnight, no daytime crowds), "Live performances" (ambient sets and sound sessions between the halls), "Guided hidden-room tours" (curators unlock rooms closed to the public). Each with a tiny inline SVG icon (frame / waveform / key) in gold.

4) PROGRAM TIMELINE (#program): serif heading "The Night, Hour by Hour". Vertical timeline: central or left gold vertical line, alternating glass cards. 8 items, each with time (gold serif), title, 1-sentence description, and a small location tag pill:
- 19:00 Doors Open — Welcome drink in the candlelit foyer as the galleries awaken. · Grand Foyer
- 19:30 Curator Welcome — Chief curator opens the night with the story of the collection. · Main Hall
- 20:00 Hidden Collection Tour — Rarely shown works from the vault, in small guided groups. · Vault Rooms
- 21:00 Live Ambient Performance — A slow-burning modular set among the sculptures. · Sculpture Hall
- 22:00 Sculpture Hall Projection — Large-scale light projection mapped onto marble. · Sculpture Hall
- 23:00 Artist Talk — In-conversation with this year's exhibiting artists. · Auditorium
- 00:00 Midnight Gallery Walk — A silent torchlit walk through the sleeping galleries. · East Wing
- 01:00 Closing Sound Session — A final deep listening session to close the night. · Main Hall

5) ARTISTS / SPEAKERS (#artists): heading "Voices of the Night". Asymmetric grid of 8 cards (varying spans/offsets on desktop, stacked on mobile). Each card: image (top, slight grayscale→color on hover, zoom), name (serif), role (gold small caps), 1-line teaser, "View details" button (ghost, small). Data (name / role / teaser / session time / image):
1. Elena Marchetti — Sound Artist — sculpts slow ambient worlds from modular synths and field recordings. — 21:00 · Sculpture Hall — img https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?exhibition,lights
2. Jonas Kowalczyk — Light & Projection Artist — paints architecture with mapped light. — 22:00 · Sculpture Hall — img https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art
3. Dr. Anna Zielińska — Chief Curator — keeper of the hidden collection for fifteen years. — 19:30 · Main Hall — img https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?sculpture,museum
4. Malik Osei — Installation Artist — builds quiet rooms of memory and dust. — 23:00 · Auditorium — img https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?art,installation
5. Sofia Lindqvist — Pianist & Composer — prepares piano with paper, felt and midnight. — 01:00 · Main Hall — img https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?theater,stage
6. Tomasz Wrona — Tour Guide & Historian — knows every locked door in the building. — 20:00 · Vault Rooms — img https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?museum,crowd
7. Yuki Tanaka — Visual Artist — works between ink, shadow and projection. — 23:00 · Auditorium — reuse https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art
8. The Velvet Ensemble — Sound Collective — four musicians, one long nocturne. — 00:00 · East Wing — reuse https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?exhibition,lights
Each artist has a longer 2–3 sentence bio stored in JS data for the modal.
ARTIST MODAL: <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby> hidden by default; dark backdrop blur; centered glass panel with image, name, role, session time, longer bio, gold "Close" button and an × corner button. Opens on "View details" (populated from JS data), closes on ×, Close button, ESC key, and backdrop click. Focus moves into modal on open and returns to trigger on close; body scroll locked while open.

6) VENUE (#venue): heading "The Old Gallery". Two-column: left = info panel(s): venue name "The Old Gallery", address "ul. Muzealna 12, 00-841 Warsaw"; travel tips (arrive early, cloakroom, last entry 23:30); accessibility notes (step-free entrance on the north side, lifts to all floors, accessible restrooms, quiet room available); parking/transport (metro M2 "Świętokrzyska" 6 min walk, bus lines 107/171 stop "Muzealna", limited paid parking behind the gallery). Right = INLINE SVG MAP MOCK (hand-drawn feel, dark panel background): a burgundy/navy rectangle block labeled "The Old Gallery", nearby thin street lines (muted strokes) with tiny street labels, a metro marker circle "M" and bus marker "B" in gold, an entrance marker (gold dot/diamond labeled "Entrance"), and a dashed gold route polyline from the metro marker to the entrance. Decorative, aria-hidden with a visually-hidden caption.

7) TICKET TIERS (#tickets): heading "Choose Your Pass". 3 premium glass cards, middle one elevated/scaled with a gold "RECOMMENDED" badge ribbon:
- Night Pass — €29 — Entry after 19:00 · Main exhibition access · Program access
- Curator Pass — €59 (RECOMMENDED) — Everything in Night Pass · Hidden collection tour · Reserved artist talk seating
- Patron Pass — €129 — Everything in Curator Pass · VIP lounge access · Signed event print · Priority entrance
Features as gold-check list items. Each card: "Select Night Pass"/etc. button; hover highlight (lift, gold border, soft glow).
TICKET CHECKOUT MODAL (mock, no payment): same accessible modal pattern. Shows selected tier name + unit price; form fields: attendee name (text, required), email (required, validated), number of tickets (select or number 1–6), live-computed total price (€ × qty, updates on change), required checkbox "I agree to the event terms and house rules", gold "Confirm Reservation" button. Inline validation messages under fields (red-ish soft gold tone), shake/invalid styling. On valid submit: close modal and show success toast "Reservation confirmed — X × Tier Name (€total). Check your inbox (demo)." No real payment.

8) FAQ (#faq): heading "Questions, Answered". Accordion of 6 items (button + panel, aria-expanded, smooth max-height/opacity animation, gold chevron rotates, only one open at a time):
- Is payment processed on this page? → No. This is a demonstration checkout — your reservation is recorded locally and no payment is taken.
- Can I arrive late? → Yes, last entry is 23:30; some timed tours require punctuality.
- Are photos allowed? → Non-flash photography is welcome in most halls; tripods and flash are not.
- Is the venue accessible? → Step-free north entrance, lifts to all floors, accessible restrooms, quiet room.
- Can I change my ticket tier? → Yes, up to 7 days before the event via the link in your confirmation email (demo).
- How do I save the event to my calendar? → Use the "Save to Calendar" button — it downloads an .ics file you can import anywhere.

9) NEWSLETTER (#newsletter): glass panel: serif heading "Letters from the Museum", short line, email input + gold "Subscribe" button inline. Inline validation (empty/invalid email → message under field). On success: toast "You're on the list — see you after dark." and clear input.

10) FOOTER: thin gold top divider; serif "ARTIFACT" logo; credits line "A night produced with The Old Gallery, Warsaw"; social-style text links (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube — href="#" with rel and aria-labels); copyright "© 2026 ARTIFACT: Museum Night"; small muted note: "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase."

=== JAVASCRIPT (vanilla, at end of body, wrapped in IIFE or DOMContentLoaded, no console errors) ===
- Mobile menu toggle.
- Smooth scrolling for anchor links (CSS scroll-behavior + JS fallback not needed; ensure offset via scroll-padding-top).
- Active nav state: IntersectionObserver on sections (#program,#artists,#venue,#tickets,#faq) toggling .active on matching nav links.
- Scroll reveal: IntersectionObserver adding .visible to .reveal elements (stagger via transition-delay from data-index or nth-child).
- Artist data array (the 8 artists above incl. bios) + modal open/close logic (ESC, backdrop click, focus management, body scroll lock).
- Ticket modal: open with tier data (name, price) from data-* attributes; qty→total recompute; validation (name ≥2 chars, email regex, terms checked); success → close + toast.
- FAQ accordion (single-open, aria-expanded, animated).
- Newsletter validation + toast.
- Toast system: fixed bottom-right container, creates toast divs (glass, gold left border, slide-in), auto-dismiss ~4s, role="status" aria-live="polite".
- SAVE TO CALENDAR: on click of the hero "Save to Calendar" button, build an .ics string client-side and download via Blob + temporary <a download>:
  BEGIN:VCALENDAR / VERSION:2.0 / PRODID:-//ARTIFACT//Museum Night//EN / BEGIN:VEVENT / UID:artifact-museum-night-2026@artifact / DTSTAMP:(generated) / DTSTART:20261018T190000 / DTEND:20261019T020000 / SUMMARY:ARTIFACT: Museum Night / LOCATION:The Old Gallery, Warsaw / DESCRIPTION:A cinematic after-hours museum event with exhibitions, performances, talks, and guided tours. / END:VEVENT / END:VCALENDAR
  Blob type "text/calendar", filename "artifact-museum-night.ics", revoke object URL after click; show toast "Calendar file downloaded."
- Guard everything (elements exist before listeners); zero console errors.

=== RESPONSIVE ===
Mobile (<860px): hamburger menu; hero headline scales down; timeline stacks; artist grid single column; ticket cards stack (recommended card not scaled); venue columns stack; modals near-fullscreen with padding. Touch-friendly tap targets.

Write the COMPLETE file — full CSS and full JS, every section implemented, nothing stubbed, no TODOs."}
